text: La pentola è molto calda!

tr.en: The pot is very hot!
tr.nl: De pan is heel heet!

text: Mettiamo l'acqua in pentola.

tr.en: Let's put the water in the pot.
tr.nl: Laten we het water in de pan doen.

text: Dov'è la pentola grande?

tr.en: Where is the big pot?
tr.nl: Waar is de grote pan?

text: Il sugo di pomodoro è pronto.

tr.en: The tomato sauce is ready.
tr.nl: De tomatensaus is klaar.

text: Puoi assaggiare il sugo?

tr.en: Can you taste the sauce?
tr.nl: Kun jij de saus even proeven?

text: Pensiamo di mangiare fuori.

tr.en: We're thinking of eating out.
tr.nl: We denken erover om uit eten te gaan.

text: Loro aspettano il treno.

tr.en: They're waiting for the train.
tr.nl: Zij wachten op de trein.

text: Loro lasciano la macchina qui.

tr.en: They leave the car here.
tr.nl: Zij laten de auto hier staan.

text: Voi chiamate un taxi?

tr.en: Are you calling a taxi?
tr.nl: Bellen jullie een taxi?

text: Non entriamo senza Lucia.

tr.en: We're not going in without Lucia.
tr.nl: We gaan niet naar binnen zonder Lucia.

text: Entrano senza parlare.

tr.en: They come in without talking.
tr.nl: Ze komen binnen zonder te praten.

text: I treni passano qui.

tr.en: The trains come through here.
tr.nl: De treinen komen hier langs.

text: Da qui vediamo il mare.

tr.en: From here we can see the sea.
tr.nl: Van hieruit zien we de zee.

text: Gli studenti prendono il treno per Milano.

tr.en: The students take the train to Milan.
tr.nl: De studenten nemen de trein naar Milaan.

text: Le ragazze prendono l'autobus.

tr.en: The girls take the bus.
tr.nl: De meisjes nemen de bus.

text: Gli stranieri chiedono la strada.

tr.en: The foreigners ask for directions.
tr.nl: De buitenlanders vragen de weg.

text: Metto la pizza in forno.

tr.en: I'm putting the pizza in the oven.
tr.nl: Ik zet de pizza in de oven.

text: Mettiamo la torta in forno.

tr.en: We're putting the cake in the oven.
tr.nl: We zetten de taart in de oven.

text: Dove mettete le valigie?

tr.en: Where are you putting the suitcases?
tr.nl: Waar zetten jullie de koffers?

text: Loro mettono il pollo in forno.

tr.en: They put the chicken in the oven.
tr.nl: Zij zetten de kip in de oven.

text: Vivete in centro?

tr.en: Do you live in the center?
tr.nl: Wonen jullie in het centrum?

text: Aspettiamo Luca e perdiamo il treno.

tr.en: We wait for Luca and miss the train.
tr.nl: We wachten op Luca en missen de trein.

text: Ragazzi, voi perdete il treno!

tr.en: Guys, you're going to miss the train!
tr.nl: Jongens, jullie missen de trein!

text: Ricevi la posta qui?

tr.en: Do you get your mail here?
tr.nl: Krijg je je post hier?

text: Voi ricevete la posta?

tr.en: Do you get the mail?
tr.nl: Krijgen jullie de post?

text: Voi mettete il pesce in forno?

tr.en: Are you putting the fish in the oven?
tr.nl: Zetten jullie de vis in de oven?

text: Noi riceviamo la posta qui.

tr.en: We get our mail here.
tr.nl: Wij krijgen onze post hier.

text: Gli studenti ricevono il pranzo a scuola.

tr.en: The students get lunch at school.
tr.nl: De studenten krijgen lunch op school.

text: Il bambino scopre il mare.

tr.en: The child discovers the sea.
tr.nl: Het kind ontdekt de zee.

text: Noi scopriamo il mondo con i bambini.

tr.en: We discover the world with the children.
tr.nl: We ontdekken de wereld met de kinderen.

text: Scoprite Venezia in barca?

tr.en: Are you exploring Venice by boat?
tr.nl: Ontdekken jullie Venetië per boot?

text: Scoprite l'Italia in treno?

tr.en: Are you exploring Italy by train?
tr.nl: Ontdekken jullie Italië met de trein?

text: Gli amici scoprono un bar a Milano.

tr.en: The friends discover a bar in Milan.
tr.nl: De vrienden ontdekken een café in Milaan.

text: Offri anche il dolce?

tr.en: Are you paying for dessert too?
tr.nl: Trakteer je ook op het toetje?

text: Partite in treno?

tr.en: Are you leaving by train?
tr.nl: Gaan jullie met de trein?

text: Dove costruite la scuola?

tr.en: Where are you building the school?
tr.nl: Waar bouwen jullie de school?

text: Loro costruiscono una scuola per i bambini.

tr.en: They are building a school for the children.
tr.nl: Zij bouwen een school voor de kinderen.

text: Voi divertite gli studenti a scuola?

tr.en: Do you entertain the students at school?
tr.nl: Vermaken jullie de studenten op school?

text: Tu gestisci un negozio con il padre?

tr.en: Do you run a shop with your father?
tr.nl: Run jij een winkel met je vader?

text: Gestisci un albergo a Venezia?

tr.en: Do you run a hotel in Venice?
tr.nl: Run je een hotel in Venetië?

text: Noi gestiamo un albergo a Firenze.

tr.en: We run a hotel in Florence.
tr.nl: Wij runnen een hotel in Florence.

text: Noi non gestiamo questo bar.

tr.en: We don't run this bar.
tr.nl: Wij runnen deze bar niet.

text: Voi gestite un bar o un ristorante?

tr.en: Do you run a bar or a restaurant?
tr.nl: Runnen jullie een bar of een restaurant?

text: Gestite un albergo con la famiglia?

tr.en: Do you run a hotel with your family?
tr.nl: Runnen jullie een hotel met de familie?

text: I fratelli gestiscono un bar.

tr.en: The brothers run a bar.
tr.nl: De broers runnen een bar.

text: Le sorelle gestiscono un negozio di pane.

tr.en: The sisters run a bread shop.
tr.nl: De zussen runnen een broodwinkel.

text: Soffro senza caffè.

tr.en: I suffer without coffee.
tr.nl: Zonder koffie lijd ik.

text: Tu soffri senza la famiglia?

tr.en: Do you suffer without your family?
tr.nl: Lijd jij zonder je familie?

text: Soffrite senza la pizza?

tr.en: Do you suffer without pizza?
tr.nl: Lijden jullie zonder pizza?

text: Tu impazzisci per il cioccolato.

tr.en: You're crazy about chocolate.
tr.nl: Jij bent gek op chocola.

text: Voi impazzite per i dolci.

tr.en: You're crazy about sweets.
tr.nl: Jullie zijn gek op zoetigheid.

text: I turisti impazziscono per Venezia.

tr.en: Tourists are crazy about Venice.
tr.nl: Toeristen zijn gek op Venetië.

text: Gli studenti impazziscono per le vacanze.

tr.en: The students are crazy about the holidays.
tr.nl: De studenten zijn gek op de vakantie.

text: Quando escono i bambini da scuola?

tr.en: When do the children get out of school?
tr.nl: Wanneer komen de kinderen uit school?

text: Muori di fame?

tr.en: Are you starving?
tr.nl: Sterf je van de honger?

text: Il pesce muore senza acqua.

tr.en: A fish dies without water.
tr.nl: Een vis gaat dood zonder water.

text: Bambini, morite di fame? Ecco la pizza.

tr.en: Kids, are you starving? Here's the pizza.
tr.nl: Kinderen, rammelen jullie van de honger? Hier is de pizza.

text: Voi morite di sete? Ecco l'acqua.

tr.en: Are you dying of thirst? Here's the water.
tr.nl: Vergaan jullie van de dorst? Hier is het water.

text: Come ottengo una camera in questo albergo?

tr.en: How do I get a room in this hotel?
tr.nl: Hoe krijg ik een kamer in dit hotel?

text: Salgo in macchina con papà.

tr.en: I'm getting in the car with Dad.
tr.nl: Ik stap met papa in de auto.

text: Io salgo in montagna con lo zio.

tr.en: I go up into the mountains with my uncle.
tr.nl: Ik ga met mijn oom de bergen in.

text: Tu sali in macchina con noi?

tr.en: Are you getting in the car with us?
tr.nl: Stap jij bij ons in de auto?

text: Saliamo in macchina e partiamo.

tr.en: We get in the car and leave.
tr.nl: We stappen in de auto en vertrekken.

text: Noi saliamo in autobus qui.

tr.en: We get on the bus here.
tr.nl: Wij stappen hier in de bus.

text: Saliamo in montagna domenica.

tr.en: We're going up into the mountains on Sunday.
tr.nl: Zondag gaan we de bergen in.

text: Voi salite in macchina con papà?

tr.en: Are you getting in the car with Dad?
tr.nl: Stappen jullie bij papa in de auto?

text: Salite in montagna anche quest'anno?

tr.en: Are you going up into the mountains again this year?
tr.nl: Gaan jullie dit jaar ook weer de bergen in?

text: Voi salite in autobus con i bambini?

tr.en: Are you getting on the bus with the children?
tr.nl: Stappen jullie met de kinderen in de bus?

text: Loro salgono in treno a Napoli.

tr.en: They get on the train in Naples.
tr.nl: Zij stappen in Napels in de trein.

text: Come ottieni i biglietti?

tr.en: How do you get the tickets?
tr.nl: Hoe kom jij aan de kaartjes?

text: Noi otteniamo i passaporti in una settimana.

tr.en: We get the passports within a week.
tr.nl: Wij krijgen de paspoorten binnen een week.

text: Voi ottenete i biglietti da Marco?

tr.en: Do you get the tickets from Marco?
tr.nl: Krijgen jullie de kaartjes van Marco?

text: Io salgo in treno con Anna.

tr.en: I'm getting on the train with Anna.
tr.nl: Ik stap met Anna in de trein.

text: Salite in treno con noi?

tr.en: Are you getting on the train with us?
tr.nl: Stappen jullie met ons in de trein?

text: I ragazzi salgono in autobus.

tr.en: The boys get on the bus.
tr.nl: De jongens stappen in de bus.

text: I miei genitori hanno avuto una bella vacanza.

tr.en: My parents had a lovely holiday.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders hebben een fijne vakantie gehad.

text: Abbiamo fatto una torta per il compleanno della nonna.

tr.en: We made a cake for grandma's birthday.
tr.nl: We hebben een taart gebakken voor de verjaardag van oma.

text: Perché non hai voluto mangiare la zuppa?

tr.en: Why didn't you want to eat the soup?
tr.nl: Waarom wilde je de soep niet eten?

text: Abbiamo voluto vedere il mare di notte.

tr.en: We wanted to see the sea at night.
tr.nl: We wilden de zee 's nachts zien.

text: Abbiamo voluto un tavolo accanto alla finestra.

tr.en: We wanted a table next to the window.
tr.nl: We wilden een tafel bij het raam.

text: Loro hanno sempre voluto una casa al mare.

tr.en: They have always wanted a house by the sea.
tr.nl: Ze wilden altijd al een huis aan zee.

text: I turisti hanno voluto vedere il museo.

tr.en: The tourists wanted to see the museum.
tr.nl: De toeristen wilden het museum zien.

text: Tu hai potuto vedere il mare dalla camera?

tr.en: Could you see the sea from your room?
tr.nl: Kon jij de zee zien vanuit je kamer?

text: Non abbiamo potuto prendere il treno delle otto.

tr.en: We couldn't catch the eight o'clock train.
tr.nl: We konden de trein van acht uur niet halen.

text: Abbiamo potuto vedere la nonna in ospedale.

tr.en: We were able to see grandma in hospital.
tr.nl: We konden oma in het ziekenhuis zien.

text: Avete potuto mangiare durante il viaggio?

tr.en: Were you able to eat during the trip?
tr.nl: Konden jullie onderweg eten?

text: Avete potuto prendere l'autobus?

tr.en: Did you manage to catch the bus?
tr.nl: Hebben jullie de bus kunnen halen?

text: I bambini non hanno potuto giocare fuori.

tr.en: The children couldn't play outside.
tr.nl: De kinderen konden niet buiten spelen.

text: I miei genitori non hanno potuto venire al matrimonio.

tr.en: My parents couldn't come to the wedding.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders konden niet naar de bruiloft komen.

text: Non hanno potuto rispondere al telefono.

tr.en: They couldn't answer the phone.
tr.nl: Ze konden de telefoon niet opnemen.

text: Hanno potuto comprare i biglietti?

tr.en: Did they manage to buy the tickets?
tr.nl: Hebben ze de kaartjes kunnen kopen?

text: I turisti non hanno potuto entrare in chiesa.

tr.en: The tourists couldn't go into the church.
tr.nl: De toeristen konden de kerk niet in.

text: Perché hai dovuto vendere la bicicletta?

tr.en: Why did you have to sell your bike?
tr.nl: Waarom moest je je fiets verkopen?

text: Avete dovuto pagare il biglietto?

tr.en: Did you have to pay for the ticket?
tr.nl: Moesten jullie voor het kaartje betalen?

text: Avete dovuto chiamare la polizia?

tr.en: Did you have to call the police?
tr.nl: Moesten jullie de politie bellen?

text: Quando hai saputo del matrimonio?

tr.en: When did you hear about the wedding?
tr.nl: Wanneer hoorde je van de bruiloft?

text: Abbiamo saputo della nascita di Lucia dalla zia.

tr.en: We heard about Lucia's birth from our aunt.
tr.nl: We hoorden van onze tante over de geboorte van Lucia.

text: Abbiamo saputo trovare la strada senza mappa.

tr.en: We managed to find the way without a map.
tr.nl: We hebben de weg zonder kaart weten te vinden.

text: Abbiamo saputo che il negozio chiude.

tr.en: We found out that the shop is closing.
tr.nl: We hoorden dat de winkel dichtgaat.

text: Non avete saputo trovare la stazione?

tr.en: Couldn't you find the station?
tr.nl: Konden jullie het station niet vinden?

text: I miei genitori l'hanno saputo dalla televisione.

tr.en: My parents found out from the television.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders hoorden het via de televisie.

text: Hanno saputo ieri che la nonna è in ospedale.

tr.en: They found out yesterday that grandma is in hospital.
tr.nl: Ze hoorden gisteren dat oma in het ziekenhuis ligt.

text: Non l'abbiamo ancora detto ai nonni.

tr.en: We haven't told our grandparents yet.
tr.nl: We hebben het nog niet aan opa en oma verteld.

text: Perché non mi avete detto del viaggio?

tr.en: Why didn't you tell me about the trip?
tr.nl: Waarom hebben jullie me niets over de reis verteld?

text: Avete già detto buongiorno alla signora?

tr.en: Have you said good morning to the lady yet?
tr.nl: Hebben jullie de mevrouw al goedemorgen gezegd?

text: Hanno pensato di comprare una macchina nuova.

tr.en: They've been thinking about buying a new car.
tr.nl: Ze hebben erover nagedacht een nieuwe auto te kopen.

text: Loro non hanno pensato ai bambini.

tr.en: They didn't think about the children.
tr.nl: Zij hebben niet aan de kinderen gedacht.

text: Le ragazze hanno pensato alla cena.

tr.en: The girls took care of dinner.
tr.nl: De meisjes hebben voor het eten gezorgd.

text: Ieri abbiamo visto i tuoi genitori al mercato.

tr.en: Yesterday we saw your parents at the market.
tr.nl: Gisteren zagen we je ouders op de markt.

text: Abbiamo visto una casa molto bella in centro.

tr.en: We saw a really nice house in the centre.
tr.nl: We hebben een heel mooi huis in het centrum gezien.

text: I miei nipoti non hanno mai visto il mare.

tr.en: My grandchildren have never seen the sea.
tr.nl: Mijn kleinkinderen hebben de zee nog nooit gezien.

text: Le ragazze hanno visto Marco al cinema.

tr.en: The girls saw Marco at the cinema.
tr.nl: De meisjes hebben Marco in de bioscoop gezien.

text: Abbiamo preso un taxi per l'aeroporto.

tr.en: We took a taxi to the airport.
tr.nl: We hebben een taxi naar het vliegveld genomen.

text: Abbiamo preso i biglietti?

tr.en: Did we bring the tickets?
tr.nl: Hebben we de kaartjes meegenomen?

text: Abbiamo preso freddo in montagna.

tr.en: We caught a chill in the mountains.
tr.nl: We zijn in de bergen verkouden geworden.

text: I ragazzi hanno preso l'autobus delle sette.

tr.en: The boys took the seven o'clock bus.
tr.nl: De jongens hebben de bus van zeven uur genomen.

text: Hanno guardato la mappa ma non hanno trovato la strada.

tr.en: They looked at the map but didn't find the way.
tr.nl: Ze hebben op de kaart gekeken, maar de weg niet gevonden.

text: Abbiamo lasciato la macchina davanti alla stazione.

tr.en: We left the car in front of the station.
tr.nl: We hebben de auto voor het station laten staan.

text: I turisti hanno lasciato le valigie in albergo.

tr.en: The tourists left their suitcases at the hotel.
tr.nl: De toeristen hebben hun koffers in het hotel gelaten.

text: Abbiamo cercato un appartamento in centro per mesi.

tr.en: We looked for a flat in the centre for months.
tr.nl: We hebben maandenlang een appartement in het centrum gezocht.

text: Avete trovato un albergo?

tr.en: Did you find a hotel?
tr.nl: Hebben jullie een hotel gevonden?

text: Voi avete trovato lavoro in città?

tr.en: Did you find work in the city?
tr.nl: Hebben jullie werk gevonden in de stad?

text: Non hanno trovato un taxi.

tr.en: They couldn't find a taxi.
tr.nl: Ze konden geen taxi vinden.

text: Mi hanno chiesto il passaporto all'aeroporto.

tr.en: They asked me for my passport at the airport.
tr.nl: Ze vroegen op het vliegveld om mijn paspoort.

text: Le mie amiche sono venute in treno.

tr.en: My friends came by train.
tr.nl: Mijn vriendinnen kwamen met de trein.

text: Alla nonna sono sembrata molto stanca.

tr.en: I looked very tired to grandma.
tr.nl: Oma vond dat ik er erg moe uitzag.

text: Al telefono mi sei sembrata triste.

tr.en: You sounded sad on the phone.
tr.nl: Aan de telefoon klonk je verdrietig.

text: Ai miei genitori sei sembrato un bravo ragazzo.

tr.en: My parents thought you seemed like a nice boy.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders vonden je een aardige jongen.

text: Ai nonni siamo sembrati molto stanchi.

tr.en: We looked very tired to our grandparents.
tr.nl: Opa en oma vonden dat we er erg moe uitzagen.

text: Al matrimonio siamo sembrati molto felici.

tr.en: We looked very happy at the wedding.
tr.nl: We zagen er heel gelukkig uit op de bruiloft.

text: Ai turisti siete sembrati molto gentili.

tr.en: You seemed very kind to the tourists.
tr.nl: De toeristen vonden jullie erg aardig.

text: I bambini sono sembrati stanchi dopo il viaggio.

tr.en: The children seemed tired after the trip.
tr.nl: De kinderen leken moe na de reis.

text: I mesi senza di te mi sono sembrati lunghi.

tr.en: The months without you felt long to me.
tr.nl: De maanden zonder jou leken me lang.

text: Voi siete riuscite a dormire in treno?

tr.en: Did you manage to sleep on the train?
tr.nl: Konden jullie in de trein slapen?

text: Non sono riusciti a prendere il treno.

tr.en: They didn't manage to catch the train.
tr.nl: Ze hebben de trein niet gehaald.

text: Sono riusciti a comprare i biglietti?

tr.en: Did they manage to buy the tickets?
tr.nl: Is het ze gelukt kaartjes te kopen?

text: Le valigie non sono arrivate!

tr.en: The suitcases haven't arrived!
tr.nl: De koffers zijn niet aangekomen!

text: Sei morto di freddo in montagna?

tr.en: Were you freezing in the mountains?
tr.nl: Verging je van de kou in de bergen?

text: Siete quasi morti di fame, vero?

tr.en: You were nearly starving, weren't you?
tr.nl: Jullie vergingen bijna van de honger, hè?

text: Voi siete diventate amiche a scuola?

tr.en: Did you become friends at school?
tr.nl: Zijn jullie op school vriendinnen geworden?

text: Siamo passate davanti alla chiesa.

tr.en: We went past the church.
tr.nl: We zijn langs de kerk gelopen.

text: Avevamo una piccola casa al mare.

tr.en: We had a small house by the sea.
tr.nl: We hadden een klein huis aan zee.

text: Avevamo fame, ma non c'era niente in casa.

tr.en: We were hungry, but there was nothing in the house.
tr.nl: We hadden honger, maar er was niets in huis.

text: Avevate una macchina rossa, vero?

tr.en: You had a red car, didn't you?
tr.nl: Jullie hadden een rode auto, toch?

text: Perché non avevate il biglietto?

tr.en: Why didn't you have a ticket?
tr.nl: Waarom hadden jullie geen kaartje?

text: Stavamo molto bene in montagna.

tr.en: We were very happy in the mountains.
tr.nl: In de bergen hadden we het erg naar ons zin.

text: Noi stavamo in un piccolo albergo.

tr.en: We were staying in a small hotel.
tr.nl: We verbleven in een klein hotel.

text: Andavi spesso al mare da bambino?

tr.en: As a child, did you often go to the seaside?
tr.nl: Ging je als kind vaak naar zee?

text: Tu andavi a scuola in bicicletta.

tr.en: You used to go to school by bike.
tr.nl: Jij ging met de fiets naar school.

text: Andavi sempre in biblioteca il sabato.

tr.en: You always went to the library on Saturdays.
tr.nl: Je ging op zaterdag altijd naar de bibliotheek.

text: Con chi andavi in vacanza da ragazza?

tr.en: Who did you go on holiday with as a girl?
tr.nl: Met wie ging je als meisje op vakantie?

text: Quando abitavi a Milano, andavi spesso a teatro?

tr.en: When you lived in Milan, did you often go to the theatre?
tr.nl: Ging je vaak naar het theater toen je in Milaan woonde?

text: Andavamo al parco dopo la scuola.

tr.en: We went to the park after school.
tr.nl: Na school gingen we naar het park.

text: Andavamo spesso al cinema insieme.

tr.en: We often went to the cinema together.
tr.nl: We gingen vaak samen naar de bioscoop.

text: Dove andavate in vacanza da bambini?

tr.en: Where did you go on holiday as kids?
tr.nl: Waar gingen jullie als kinderen op vakantie?

text: Andavate a scuola a piedi?

tr.en: Did you walk to school?
tr.nl: Gingen jullie lopend naar school?

text: Voi andavate spesso al mercato il sabato.

tr.en: You often went to the market on Saturdays.
tr.nl: Jullie gingen op zaterdag vaak naar de markt.

text: Perché andavate così spesso in centro?

tr.en: Why did you go into town so often?
tr.nl: Waarom gingen jullie zo vaak naar de stad?

text: Non andavate mai al lago?

tr.en: Didn't you ever go to the lake?
tr.nl: Gingen jullie nooit naar het meer?

text: Io facevo colazione alle sette.

tr.en: I used to have breakfast at seven.
tr.nl: Ik ontbeet altijd om zeven uur.

text: Facevi colazione al bar ogni mattina?

tr.en: Did you have breakfast at the café every morning?
tr.nl: Ontbeet je elke ochtend in het café?

text: Che facevate la sera in montagna?

tr.en: What did you do in the evenings in the mountains?
tr.nl: Wat deden jullie 's avonds in de bergen?

text: Facevate lunghi viaggi in macchina?

tr.en: Did you take long trips by car?
tr.nl: Maakten jullie lange reizen met de auto?

text: Dovevamo essere a casa alle otto.

tr.en: We had to be home at eight.
tr.nl: We moesten om acht uur thuis zijn.

text: Sapevamo che la banca apriva alle nove.

tr.en: We knew that the bank opened at nine.
tr.nl: We wisten dat de bank om negen uur openging.

text: Voi non sapevate la strada?

tr.en: Didn't you know the way?
tr.nl: Wisten jullie de weg niet?

text: I miei genitori sapevano del matrimonio.

tr.en: My parents knew about the wedding.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders wisten van de bruiloft.

text: Sapevano che eravamo in vacanza?

tr.en: Did they know we were on holiday?
tr.nl: Wisten ze dat we op vakantie waren?

text: Io dicevo sempre di sì alla mamma.

tr.en: I always said yes to mum.
tr.nl: Ik zei altijd ja tegen mama.

text: Non dicevamo mai di no alla nonna.

tr.en: We never said no to grandma.
tr.nl: We zeiden nooit nee tegen oma.

text: Dicevamo spesso che volevamo vivere al mare.

tr.en: We often said we wanted to live by the sea.
tr.nl: We zeiden vaak dat we aan zee wilden wonen.

text: Dicevamo buongiorno all'insegnante ogni mattina.

tr.en: We said good morning to the teacher every morning.
tr.nl: We zeiden elke ochtend goedemorgen tegen de leraar.

text: Dicevamo ai nostri amici che stavamo bene.

tr.en: We told our friends we were fine.
tr.nl: We zeiden tegen onze vrienden dat het goed met ons ging.

text: Voi dicevate che la città era bella.

tr.en: You said the city was beautiful.
tr.nl: Jullie zeiden dat de stad mooi was.

text: Dicevate buongiorno alla gente per strada?

tr.en: Did you say hello to people in the street?
tr.nl: Zeiden jullie gedag tegen mensen op straat?

text: I bambini dicevano di avere fame.

tr.en: The children said they were hungry.
tr.nl: De kinderen zeiden dat ze honger hadden.

text: Vedevi il mare dalla tua camera?

tr.en: Could you see the sea from your room?
tr.nl: Kon je de zee zien vanuit je kamer?

text: Vedevi molti turisti a Venezia?

tr.en: Did you see many tourists in Venice?
tr.nl: Zag je veel toeristen in Venetië?

text: Vedevamo spesso Giovanni al bar.

tr.en: We often saw Giovanni at the café.
tr.nl: We zagen Giovanni vaak in het café.

text: Da piccoli vedevamo il mare solo in vacanza.

tr.en: As kids we only saw the sea on holiday.
tr.nl: Als kinderen zagen we de zee alleen op vakantie.

text: Vedevate le montagne dall'albergo?

tr.en: Could you see the mountains from the hotel?
tr.nl: Konden jullie de bergen zien vanuit het hotel?

text: Voi vedevate Sara ogni giorno a scuola.

tr.en: You saw Sara every day at school.
tr.nl: Jullie zagen Sara elke dag op school.

text: Voi vedevate la televisione fino a tardi.

tr.en: You watched TV until late.
tr.nl: Jullie keken tot laat televisie.

text: Vedevate il ponte da lì?

tr.en: Could you see the bridge from there?
tr.nl: Konden jullie de brug vanaf daar zien?

text: I turisti vedevano solo il centro.

tr.en: The tourists only saw the centre.
tr.nl: De toeristen zagen alleen het centrum.

text: Si vedevano ogni giorno al parco.

tr.en: They saw each other every day in the park.
tr.nl: Ze zagen elkaar elke dag in het park.

text: Loro vedevano Elena al mercato ogni venerdì.

tr.en: They saw Elena at the market every Friday.
tr.nl: Ze zagen Elena elke vrijdag op de markt.

text: Tu pensavi sempre alla tua famiglia.

tr.en: You were always thinking about your family.
tr.nl: Jij dacht altijd aan je familie.

text: Quando eri piccolo, pensavi solo al gelato.

tr.en: When you were little, you only thought about ice cream.
tr.nl: Toen je klein was, dacht je alleen aan ijs.

text: Pensavi spesso alla tua vecchia casa?

tr.en: Did you often think about your old house?
tr.nl: Dacht je vaak aan je oude huis?

text: Voi pensavate solo alla vacanza.

tr.en: You only thought about the holiday.
tr.nl: Jullie dachten alleen aan de vakantie.

text: Pensavate spesso ai vostri nonni?

tr.en: Did you often think of your grandparents?
tr.nl: Dachten jullie vaak aan jullie opa en oma?

text: Io venivo a scuola in bicicletta.

tr.en: I used to come to school by bike.
tr.nl: Ik kwam altijd met de fiets naar school.

text: Venivo spesso in questo bar con mio padre.

tr.en: I often came to this café with my father.
tr.nl: Ik kwam vaak met mijn vader in dit café.

text: Venivo a pranzo dalla nonna ogni domenica.

tr.en: I came to grandma's for lunch every Sunday.
tr.nl: Ik kwam elke zondag bij oma lunchen.

text: Io venivo sempre a questo mercato il sabato.

tr.en: I always came to this market on Saturdays.
tr.nl: Ik kwam op zaterdag altijd naar deze markt.

text: Da piccolo venivi spesso al mare con noi.

tr.en: As a little boy you often came to the seaside with us.
tr.nl: Als jongetje ging je vaak met ons mee naar zee.

text: Tu venivi a scuola a piedi?

tr.en: Did you come to school on foot?
tr.nl: Kwam jij lopend naar school?

text: Venivi sempre presto in ufficio.

tr.en: You always came to the office early.
tr.nl: Je kwam altijd vroeg op kantoor.

text: Tu venivi da lontano, vero?

tr.en: You came from far away, didn't you?
tr.nl: Jij kwam van ver, toch?

text: Con chi venivi al parco?

tr.en: Who did you use to come to the park with?
tr.nl: Met wie kwam je naar het park?

text: Venivamo spesso in questo parco da bambini.

tr.en: We often came to this park as children.
tr.nl: Als kinderen kwamen we vaak in dit park.

text: Noi venivamo sempre in treno.

tr.en: We always came by train.
tr.nl: Wij kwamen altijd met de trein.

text: Venivamo a casa tua dopo la scuola.

tr.en: We used to come to your house after school.
tr.nl: We kwamen na school naar jouw huis.

text: Quando venivamo in città, prendevamo l'autobus.

tr.en: When we came into town, we took the bus.
tr.nl: Als we naar de stad kwamen, namen we de bus.

text: Venivamo da una piccola città del sud.

tr.en: We came from a small town in the south.
tr.nl: We kwamen uit een kleine stad in het zuiden.

text: Noi venivamo a piedi, Paolo in bicicletta.

tr.en: We came on foot, Paolo by bike.
tr.nl: Wij kwamen lopend, Paolo met de fiets.

text: Voi venivate a scuola in autobus?

tr.en: Did you come to school by bus?
tr.nl: Kwamen jullie met de bus naar school?

text: Quando venivate in città, dove dormivate?

tr.en: When you came to town, where did you sleep?
tr.nl: Als jullie naar de stad kwamen, waar sliepen jullie dan?

text: Voi venivate sempre con la macchina di papà.

tr.en: You always came in Dad's car.
tr.nl: Jullie kwamen altijd met de auto van papa.

text: Parlavo al telefono quando sei arrivato.

tr.en: I was on the phone when you arrived.
tr.nl: Ik zat aan de telefoon toen je aankwam.

text: Con chi parlavi al telefono?

tr.en: Who were you talking to on the phone?
tr.nl: Met wie was je aan het bellen?

text: Parlavi troppo forte in biblioteca.

tr.en: You were talking too loudly in the library.
tr.nl: Je praatte te hard in de bibliotheek.

text: Noi parlavamo spesso di viaggi.

tr.en: We often talked about trips.
tr.nl: Wij praatten vaak over reizen.

text: Parlavamo per ore al telefono.

tr.en: We talked on the phone for hours.
tr.nl: We praatten urenlang aan de telefoon.

text: Con chi parlavate davanti alla scuola?

tr.en: Who were you talking to in front of the school?
tr.nl: Met wie stonden jullie te praten voor de school?

text: Perché non capivi la ricetta?

tr.en: Why didn't you understand the recipe?
tr.nl: Waarom begreep je het recept niet?

text: Tu capivi tutto a scuola, vero?

tr.en: You understood everything at school, didn't you?
tr.nl: Jij begreep op school alles, toch?

text: Non capivamo perché il treno non arrivava.

tr.en: We didn't understand why the train wasn't coming.
tr.nl: We begrepen niet waarom de trein niet kwam.

text: Perché non capivate la mappa?

tr.en: Why couldn't you understand the map?
tr.nl: Waarom snapten jullie de kaart niet?

text: Capivate cosa diceva il turista?

tr.en: Did you understand what the tourist was saying?
tr.nl: Verstonden jullie wat de toerist zei?

text: Al telefono non vi capivate mai.

tr.en: On the phone you never understood each other.
tr.nl: Aan de telefoon begrepen jullie elkaar nooit.

text: Sentivi il mare dalla tua camera?

tr.en: Could you hear the sea from your room?
tr.nl: Kon je vanuit je kamer de zee horen?

text: Noi sentivamo molto freddo in montagna.

tr.en: We felt very cold in the mountains.
tr.nl: Wij hadden het erg koud in de bergen.

text: Chi aspettavi davanti alla stazione?

tr.en: Who were you waiting for in front of the station?
tr.nl: Op wie wachtte je voor het station?

text: Tu aspettavi l'autobus quando ti ho visto.

tr.en: You were waiting for the bus when I saw you.
tr.nl: Jij stond op de bus te wachten toen ik je zag.

text: Voi aspettavate il treno delle otto?

tr.en: Were you waiting for the eight o'clock train?
tr.nl: Wachtten jullie op de trein van acht uur?

text: Chi aspettavate fuori dal cinema?

tr.en: Who were you waiting for outside the cinema?
tr.nl: Op wie wachtten jullie buiten de bioscoop?

text: Voi aspettavate le vacanze tutto l'anno.

tr.en: You looked forward to the holidays all year.
tr.nl: Jullie keken het hele jaar uit naar de vakantie.

text: I bambini aspettavano la mamma davanti alla scuola.

tr.en: The children were waiting for Mum in front of the school.
tr.nl: De kinderen wachtten voor de school op mama.

text: Sembravamo stanchi dopo il viaggio?

tr.en: Did we look tired after the trip?
tr.nl: Zagen we er moe uit na de reis?

text: Io prendevo sempre l'autobus quando ero studente.

tr.en: I always took the bus when I was a student.
tr.nl: Ik nam altijd de bus toen ik student was.

text: Prendevo un caffè al bar ogni mattina.

tr.en: I had a coffee at the café every morning.
tr.nl: Ik dronk elke ochtend een koffie in het café.

text: Prendevo spesso il gelato al limone.

tr.en: I often had lemon ice cream.
tr.nl: Ik nam vaak citroenijs.

text: Tu prendevi sempre la pizza con il prosciutto.

tr.en: You always had pizza with ham.
tr.nl: Jij nam altijd pizza met ham.

text: Prendevi il taxi o l'autobus?

tr.en: Did you take a taxi or the bus?
tr.nl: Nam je een taxi of de bus?

text: Prendevi la macchina di papà da ragazzo?

tr.en: As a teenager, did you take Dad's car?
tr.nl: Pakte je als tiener de auto van papa?

text: Tu prendevi il caffè senza zucchero.

tr.en: You used to take your coffee without sugar.
tr.nl: Jij dronk je koffie zonder suiker.

text: Noi prendevamo pane e burro a colazione.

tr.en: We had bread and butter for breakfast.
tr.nl: Bij het ontbijt aten we brood met boter.

text: Prendevamo sempre il tavolo accanto alla finestra.

tr.en: We always took the table next to the window.
tr.nl: We namen altijd het tafeltje bij het raam.

text: Noi prendevamo l'autobus insieme ogni giorno.

tr.en: We took the bus together every day.
tr.nl: Wij namen elke dag samen de bus.

text: Prendevamo un gelato con Giulia dopo la scuola.

tr.en: We used to get an ice cream with Giulia after school.
tr.nl: Na school haalden we een ijsje met Giulia.

text: Prendevamo il treno per andare in montagna.

tr.en: We took the train to go to the mountains.
tr.nl: We namen de trein naar de bergen.

text: Non prendevamo mai il taxi, costava troppo.

tr.en: We never took a taxi; it cost too much.
tr.nl: We namen nooit een taxi, dat was te duur.

text: Dopo cena prendevamo un caffè in piazza.

tr.en: After dinner we had a coffee in the square.
tr.nl: Na het eten dronken we een koffie op het plein.

text: Voi prendevate l'autobus per andare a scuola?

tr.en: Did you take the bus to school?
tr.nl: Namen jullie de bus naar school?

text: Prendevate il caffè al bar o a casa?

tr.en: Did you have your coffee at the café or at home?
tr.nl: Dronken jullie je koffie in het café of thuis?

text: Voi prendevate il pesce al mercato il venerdì.

tr.en: On Fridays you used to buy fish at the market.
tr.nl: Op vrijdag haalden jullie vis op de markt.

text: Perché prendevate sempre la macchina?

tr.en: Why did you always take the car?
tr.nl: Waarom namen jullie altijd de auto?

text: Voi prendevate spesso il treno di notte.

tr.en: You often took the night train.
tr.nl: Jullie namen vaak de nachttrein.

text: I miei genitori prendevano sempre il treno.

tr.en: My parents always took the train.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders namen altijd de trein.

text: I bambini prendevano i biscotti senza chiedere.

tr.en: The children took the biscuits without asking.
tr.nl: De kinderen pakten de koekjes zonder te vragen.

text: Penserai a me durante il viaggio?

tr.en: Will you think of me during the trip?
tr.nl: Denk je onderweg aan mij?

text: Tu penserai alla cena stasera?

tr.en: Will you take care of dinner tonight?
tr.nl: Zorg jij vanavond voor het eten?

text: Penseremo noi alla torta.

tr.en: We'll take care of the cake.
tr.nl: Wij zorgen voor de taart.

text: Durante le vacanze non penseremo alla scuola.

tr.en: During the holidays we won't think about school.
tr.nl: In de vakantie denken we niet aan school.

text: Dopo cena penseremo al viaggio.

tr.en: After dinner we'll think about the trip.
tr.nl: Na het eten denken we na over de reis.

text: Voi penserete al pane e al vino.

tr.en: You'll take care of the bread and the wine.
tr.nl: Jullie zorgen voor het brood en de wijn.

text: Penserete voi ai biglietti?

tr.en: Will you take care of the tickets?
tr.nl: Regelen jullie de kaartjes?

text: Capiremo dove andare con la mappa.

tr.en: With the map we'll work out where to go.
tr.nl: Met de kaart zien we wel waar we heen moeten.

text: Mi sentirò solo senza di te.

tr.en: I'll feel lonely without you.
tr.nl: Zonder jou zal ik me eenzaam voelen.

text: Stasera sentirò la nonna al telefono.

tr.en: Tonight I'll talk to grandma on the phone.
tr.nl: Vanavond bel ik met oma.

text: Sentirete il mare dalla camera.

tr.en: You'll hear the sea from the bedroom.
tr.nl: Vanuit de slaapkamer horen jullie de zee.

text: Loro sentiranno freddo in montagna.

tr.en: They'll feel cold in the mountains.
tr.nl: In de bergen krijgen ze het koud.

text: Ci sentiranno dalla strada?

tr.en: Will they hear us from the street?
tr.nl: Horen ze ons vanaf de straat?

text: Mi aspetterai alla stazione?

tr.en: Will you wait for me at the station?
tr.nl: Wacht je op me bij het station?

text: Ci aspetterete davanti al cinema?

tr.en: Will you wait for us in front of the cinema?
tr.nl: Wachten jullie op ons voor de bioscoop?

text: I bambini aspetteranno la mamma a scuola.

tr.en: The children will wait for mum at school.
tr.nl: De kinderen wachten op school op mama.

text: Sembrerò stanco dopo il viaggio.

tr.en: After the trip I'll look tired.
tr.nl: Na de reis zal ik er moe uitzien.

text: Sembrerò piccolo accanto a mio fratello.

tr.en: Next to my brother I'll look small.
tr.nl: Naast mijn broer lijk ik klein.

text: Sembrerai stanco dopo la notte in treno.

tr.en: You'll look tired after the night on the train.
tr.nl: Na de nacht in de trein zie je er moe uit.

text: Ai miei genitori tu sembrerai un bravo ragazzo.

tr.en: To my parents you'll seem like a good boy.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders zullen je een brave jongen vinden.

text: Sembrerai alta accanto a lui.

tr.en: Next to him you'll look tall.
tr.nl: Naast hem lijk je lang.

text: Senza il divano la stanza sembrerà grande.

tr.en: Without the sofa the room will look big.
tr.nl: Zonder de bank lijkt de kamer groot.

text: Senza di te la casa sembrerà vuota.

tr.en: Without you the house will feel empty.
tr.nl: Zonder jou voelt het huis leeg.

text: Sembreremo troppo giovani ai tuoi genitori?

tr.en: Will we seem too young to your parents?
tr.nl: Vinden je ouders ons te jong?

text: Sembreremo ricchi con questa macchina.

tr.en: We'll look rich with this car.
tr.nl: Met deze auto lijken we rijk.

text: Ai miei nonni voi sembrerete molto giovani.

tr.en: You'll seem very young to my grandparents.
tr.nl: Mijn opa en oma zullen jullie heel jong vinden.

text: Sembrerete due turisti con questa mappa.

tr.en: You'll look like two tourists with this map.
tr.nl: Met deze kaart lijken jullie net twee toeristen.

text: Dall'aereo le case sembreranno piccole.

tr.en: From the plane the houses will look small.
tr.nl: Vanuit het vliegtuig zien de huizen er klein uit.

text: Senza di voi i giorni sembreranno lunghi.

tr.en: Without you the days will seem long.
tr.nl: Zonder jullie zullen de dagen lang lijken.

text: Guarderai il mare dalla finestra.

tr.en: From the window you'll look at the sea.
tr.nl: Vanuit het raam kijk je naar de zee.

text: Non guarderai la televisione fino a sabato.

tr.en: You won't watch TV until Saturday.
tr.nl: Je kijkt tot zaterdag geen tv.

text: Voi guarderete le valigie, va bene?

tr.en: You'll keep an eye on the suitcases, okay?
tr.nl: Jullie letten op de koffers, goed?

text: I turisti guarderanno la città dal ponte.

tr.en: The tourists will look at the city from the bridge.
tr.nl: De toeristen bekijken de stad vanaf de brug.

text: Tu cercherai un albergo per sabato?

tr.en: Will you look for a hotel for Saturday?
tr.nl: Zoek jij een hotel voor zaterdag?

text: Cercherai il libro in biblioteca?

tr.en: Will you look for the book in the library?
tr.nl: Zoek je het boek in de bibliotheek?

text: Se perdi il passaporto, lo cercherai per ore.

tr.en: If you lose your passport, you'll look for it for hours.
tr.nl: Als je je paspoort kwijtraakt, zoek je er urenlang naar.

text: Cercheremo un ristorante in centro.

tr.en: We'll look for a restaurant in the centre.
tr.nl: We zoeken een restaurant in het centrum.

text: Cercherete un taxi alla stazione?

tr.en: Will you look for a taxi at the station?
tr.nl: Zoeken jullie een taxi bij het station?

text: I turisti chiederanno la strada per il museo.

tr.en: The tourists will ask the way to the museum.
tr.nl: De toeristen vragen de weg naar het museum.

text: Ti chiederanno il passaporto all'aeroporto.

tr.en: They'll ask you for your passport at the airport.
tr.nl: Op het vliegveld vragen ze je om je paspoort.

text: In vacanza i ragazzi conosceranno nuovi amici.

tr.en: On holiday the kids will make new friends.
tr.nl: Op vakantie leren de kinderen nieuwe vrienden kennen.

text: Al matrimonio conosceranno i miei cugini.

tr.en: At the wedding they'll meet my cousins.
tr.nl: Op de bruiloft ontmoeten ze mijn neven.

text: Con il tempo conosceranno la città.

tr.en: In time they'll get to know the city.
tr.nl: Met de tijd leren ze de stad kennen.

text: Io servirò il dolce, tu prendi i piatti.

tr.en: I'll serve dessert, you get the plates.
tr.nl: Ik serveer het toetje, jij pakt de borden.

text: Servirò il pranzo alle due.

tr.en: I'll serve lunch at two.
tr.nl: Ik serveer de lunch om twee uur.

text: Servirò la zuppa calda.

tr.en: I'll serve the soup hot.
tr.nl: Ik serveer de soep warm.

text: Servirai la cena alle otto?

tr.en: Will you serve dinner at eight?
tr.nl: Serveer je het eten om acht uur?

text: Domani servirai il pranzo ai nonni.

tr.en: Tomorrow you'll serve lunch to your grandparents.
tr.nl: Morgen serveer jij de lunch voor opa en oma.

text: Serviremo vino e birra al matrimonio.

tr.en: At the wedding we'll serve wine and beer.
tr.nl: Op de bruiloft schenken we wijn en bier.

text: Serviremo succo di frutta ai bambini.

tr.en: We'll serve the children fruit juice.
tr.nl: We schenken de kinderen vruchtensap.

text: Serviremo la zuppa con il pane caldo.

tr.en: We'll serve the soup with warm bread.
tr.nl: We serveren de soep met warm brood.

text: Voi servirete il dolce alle dieci.

tr.en: You'll serve dessert at ten.
tr.nl: Jullie serveren het toetje om tien uur.

text: Noi saremo pronti alle otto.

tr.en: We'll be ready at eight.
tr.nl: We zijn om acht uur klaar.

text: Domani le strade saranno piene di turisti.

tr.en: Tomorrow the streets will be full of tourists.
tr.nl: Morgen zijn de straten vol toeristen.

text: Loro saranno in vacanza per due settimane.

tr.en: They'll be on holiday for two weeks.
tr.nl: Ze zijn twee weken op vakantie.

text: Domani vorrò dormire fino a tardi.

tr.en: Tomorrow I'll want to sleep late.
tr.nl: Morgen wil ik uitslapen.

text: Quando sarò vecchio, vorrò vivere al mare.

tr.en: When I'm old, I'll want to live by the sea.
tr.nl: Als ik oud ben, wil ik aan zee wonen.

text: Tu vorrai dormire dopo il viaggio.

tr.en: You'll want to sleep after the trip.
tr.nl: Na de reis wil je vast slapen.

text: Voi vorrete vedere il museo, vero?

tr.en: You'll want to see the museum, right?
tr.nl: Jullie willen het museum zien, toch?

text: Non vorrete partire senza colazione.

tr.en: You won't want to leave without breakfast.
tr.nl: Jullie willen vast niet zonder ontbijt vertrekken.

text: Potrai prendere l'autobus con questo biglietto.

tr.en: You'll be able to take the bus with this ticket.
tr.nl: Met dit kaartje kun je de bus nemen.

text: Tu potrai dormire nella mia camera.

tr.en: You'll be able to sleep in my room.
tr.nl: Jij kunt in mijn kamer slapen.

text: Tu potrai prendere la mia bicicletta.

tr.en: You'll be able to take my bike.
tr.nl: Jij kunt mijn fiets nemen.

text: Domani Lucia potrà tornare a scuola.

tr.en: Tomorrow Lucia will be able to go back to school.
tr.nl: Morgen kan Lucia weer naar school.

text: Mio fratello non potrà venire al matrimonio.

tr.en: My brother won't be able to come to the wedding.
tr.nl: Mijn broer kan niet naar de bruiloft komen.

text: Potremo andare al mare domenica?

tr.en: Will we be able to go to the seaside on Sunday?
tr.nl: Kunnen we zondag naar zee?

text: Voi potrete dormire sul divano.

tr.en: You'll be able to sleep on the sofa.
tr.nl: Jullie kunnen op de bank slapen.

text: Domani potrete fare il bagno al mare.

tr.en: Tomorrow you'll be able to swim in the sea.
tr.nl: Morgen kunnen jullie in zee zwemmen.

text: Non potrete entrare senza biglietto.

tr.en: You won't be able to get in without a ticket.
tr.nl: Zonder kaartje kunnen jullie niet naar binnen.

text: Potrete vedere il lago dal treno.

tr.en: You'll be able to see the lake from the train.
tr.nl: Vanuit de trein kunnen jullie het meer zien.

text: Voi potrete usare la nostra macchina.

tr.en: You'll be able to use our car.
tr.nl: Jullie kunnen onze auto gebruiken.

text: I bambini potranno giocare nel parco.

tr.en: The children will be able to play in the park.
tr.nl: De kinderen kunnen in het park spelen.

text: Loro potranno prendere il treno delle otto.

tr.en: They'll be able to catch the eight o'clock train.
tr.nl: Ze kunnen de trein van acht uur nemen.

text: Gli studenti potranno usare la biblioteca.

tr.en: The students will be able to use the library.
tr.nl: De studenten mogen de bibliotheek gebruiken.

text: Come saprai quando arriva il treno?

tr.en: How will you know when the train arrives?
tr.nl: Hoe weet je wanneer de trein aankomt?

text: Saprete arrivare alla stazione?

tr.en: Will you know how to get to the station?
tr.nl: Weten jullie de weg naar het station?

text: Tra un mese i bambini sapranno nuotare.

tr.en: In a month the children will be able to swim.
tr.nl: Over een maand kunnen de kinderen zwemmen.

text: Dalla finestra vedranno il mare.

tr.en: From the window they'll see the sea.
tr.nl: Vanuit het raam zien ze de zee.

text: I miei cugini verranno in treno.

tr.en: My cousins will come by train.
tr.nl: Mijn neven komen met de trein.

text: Terremo le bottiglie in cucina.

tr.en: We'll keep the bottles in the kitchen.
tr.nl: We bewaren de flessen in de keuken.

text: Terrete la macchina o la venderete?

tr.en: Will you keep the car or sell it?
tr.nl: Houden jullie de auto of verkopen jullie hem?

text: Voi terrete la casa al mare?

tr.en: Will you keep the house by the sea?
tr.nl: Houden jullie het huis aan zee?

text: Gli studenti terranno i libri a scuola.

tr.en: The students will keep their books at school.
tr.nl: De leerlingen bewaren hun boeken op school.

text: Credo che terranno il negozio.

tr.en: I think they'll keep the shop.
tr.nl: Ik denk dat ze de winkel houden.

text: I miei genitori terranno la macchina del nonno.

tr.en: My parents will keep grandpa's car.
tr.nl: Mijn ouders houden de auto van opa.

text: Un giorno noi vivremo in montagna.

tr.en: One day we'll live in the mountains.
tr.nl: Ooit gaan we in de bergen wonen.

text: Dove vivremo dopo la nascita del bambino?

tr.en: Where will we live after the baby is born?
tr.nl: Waar gaan we wonen als de baby er is?

text: Non vivremo sempre in questa città.

tr.en: We won't live in this city forever.
tr.nl: We blijven niet altijd in deze stad wonen.

text: Vivrete in un paese piccolo?

tr.en: Will you live in a small village?
tr.nl: Gaan jullie in een klein dorp wonen?

text: Vivranno in un appartamento in centro.

tr.en: They'll live in a flat in the centre.
tr.nl: Ze gaan in een appartement in het centrum wonen.

text: Vivranno su un'isola per un anno.

tr.en: They'll live on an island for a year.
tr.nl: Ze gaan een jaar op een eiland wonen.

text: Rimarrai in ufficio fino a tardi?

tr.en: Will you stay at the office until late?
tr.nl: Blijf je tot laat op kantoor?

text: Rimarrete qui fino a domenica?

tr.en: Will you stay here until Sunday?
tr.nl: Blijven jullie hier tot zondag?

text: Rimarrete al mare per una settimana?

tr.en: Will you stay at the seaside for a week?
tr.nl: Blijven jullie een week aan zee?

text: Rimarrete amici anche dopo la scuola.

tr.en: You'll stay friends even after school.
tr.nl: Jullie blijven vrienden, ook na school.

text: I bambini rimarranno a scuola fino alle quattro.

tr.en: The children will stay at school until four.
tr.nl: De kinderen blijven tot vier uur op school.

text: Loro rimarranno in albergo per tre notti.

tr.en: They'll stay at the hotel for three nights.
tr.nl: Ze blijven drie nachten in het hotel.

text: Le ragazze rimarranno in spiaggia fino a sera.

tr.en: The girls will stay on the beach until evening.
tr.nl: De meisjes blijven tot de avond op het strand.

text: Lei berrà un succo d'arancia.

tr.en: She'll have an orange juice.
tr.nl: Zij neemt een sinaasappelsap.

text: Stasera berremo il vino del nonno.

tr.en: Tonight we'll drink grandpa's wine.
tr.nl: Vanavond drinken we de wijn van opa.

text: Berremo il caffè in piazza.

tr.en: We'll have coffee in the square.
tr.nl: We drinken koffie op het plein.

text: Berremo un tè caldo in montagna.

tr.en: We'll have a hot tea in the mountains.
tr.nl: In de bergen drinken we een warme thee.

text: Berrete latte o succo a colazione?

tr.en: Will you have milk or juice at breakfast?
tr.nl: Drinken jullie melk of sap bij het ontbijt?

text: Stasera berrete una tazza di cioccolato caldo.

tr.en: Tonight you'll have a cup of hot chocolate.
tr.nl: Vanavond drinken jullie een kop warme chocolademelk.

text: I bambini berranno succo di frutta.

tr.en: The children will drink fruit juice.
tr.nl: De kinderen drinken vruchtensap.

text: Le ragazze berranno un tè al limone.

tr.en: The girls will have a lemon tea.
tr.nl: De meisjes drinken een citroenthee.
